name: Workshop Vertex AI (Angular + Flutter)
postCreateCommand:
flutter config --enable-web && npm install -g @angular/cli && (cd angular/memoria && npm install) && (cd mobile/app && flutter pub get) && printf 'alias setup-firebase="node %s/setup-firebase.mjs"
alias run-angular="npm --prefix %s/angular/memoria run start:codespace"
alias run-flutter="cd %s/mobile/app && flutter run -d web-server --web-port 8080 --web-hostname 0.0.0.0"
' "$(pwd)" "$(pwd)" "$(pwd)" >> ~/.bashrc
